about:
Pro-Serv Food Equipment LLC is based in New Bern, North Carolina. Founded in 2018 by Jared and Maria Shepherd, the family-owned business emerged from Jared’s background in commercial kitchen equipment and Maria’s experience in the restaurant sector, combining technical expertise with operational insight.

The company provides commercial food equipment services across North Carolina and bordering South Carolina counties. Its offerings include repair, sales, installation, preventative maintenance, and refrigerated box truck rental for all brands of hot-side and cold-side equipment. CFESA-certified technicians deliver 24/7 support with same-day emergency response, operating trucks stocked as mobile warehouses.

Pro-Serv serves commercial kitchens, restaurants, and food-service operations throughout North Carolina and adjacent South Carolina counties, including major metros such as Charlotte, Raleigh, Greensboro, Winston-Salem, and Wilmington. Its clients range from independent restaurants to larger facilities requiring HVAC and refrigeration support.

The company was founded to reshape the commercial kitchen service landscape by empowering small businesses with reliable, rapid-response support. Its stated differentiators include same-day emergency service, fully stocked service trucks, CFESA-certified expertise, and a customer-first approach rooted in family values.
